target_selection: Aave report rows tie economically; canonical ID is only a deterministic representative, not a profit or acquisition-cost ranking. Exclude known denied target from a new acquisition suggestion.

packet.data: Canonical block/header, transaction membership/index and full receipt including LiquidationCall and token logs
packet.decision: Verify identity, status, actual debt/collateral amounts, gas; raw token units/decimals and runtime binding.

packet.data: Full internal/native/token flow trace or equivalent authenticated state changes, sale fills and all participants
packet.decision: Determine actual collateral sale, flash inflow/repayment/premium, gas, protocol fee and competitive transfers without double counting. Receipt alone cannot expose every native payment.

packet.data: Applicable financing and sponsorship obligations, refunds, off-chain costs and loss/no-recourse terms
packet.decision: Separate executor, financier, builder/proposer economics; prove positive residual and no personal liability.

packet.data: Amount-specific liquidity and financing availability at exact decision time, competition and timing evidence
packet.decision: Decide whether NQC can replicate/capture; historical winner does not prove availability.

source_requirement.identity: No permitted, complete archive source established. Future package would need a public historical artifact or owner-authorized archival export with verifiable provenance; this is not permission to bypass denied explorer/RPC access.
source_requirement.lawful_alternative: Analyze an already published complete artifact if independently identified and permitted; none located within this bounded review.

later_only_if_margin_survives: Parent account/storage/code witnesses, exact prefix, fork/system inputs for replay. Do not spend on full replay while sales and liabilities are unknown.

financing.Aave: Documentary flashLoanSimple or flashLoan mode 0 can provide temporary principal if reserve permits; amount, premium, approval and repayment must be verified. Does not fund upfront ETH gas.
financing.Morpho: Inherited collateral-first callback may avoid full principal advance, subject to sale, repayment and runtime evidence.
financing.gas: NQC057: documentary conditional Titan/Quasar support; no committed financier or personal-no-recourse proof. Owner reports Titan contacted and reply pending; not independently verified, no new contact.

claim: Information value is conditional: one complete ledger can reject a route or bound its residual. No assigned probability, acquisition price, expected profit, or monthly forecast.
